---
title: "Is There a Free Market Economist in the House?"
date: "2011-06-10"
categories: ["Classical Liberalism", "Economics"]
---

In this week’s [Ideas@TheCentre](http://cis.org.au/publications/ideasthecentre/article/3046-is-there-a-free-market-economist-in-the-house), I anticipate the results of a survey of the policy views of the members of the Economics Society of Australia, drawing on similar surveys of US economists by Dan Klein, Charlotta Stern and Robert Whaples.
